Messages.Author: Francois Villon
Messages.Body:
1) can Beast the leatherface enter combat with a vamp with a Haven Uncovered
on him (by using it, obviously, so with a +1 stealth action)?

2) A is bleeding me; my B tries to block; A plays sup. Feceless night and
passes through, then he plays Threats; can B play a Deflection before being
tapped?

Messages.Author: Roger Carhult
Messages.Body:
--

"Francois Villon" <federi...@libero.it> wrote in message
news:6cnR6.4612$i71.1...@news.infostrada.it...

> 1) can Beast the leatherface enter combat with a vamp with a Haven
Uncovered
> on him (by using it, obviously, so with a +1 stealth action)?

" Beast cannot perform action-card actions or recruit allies." Haven
Uncovered isn't an action-card action, so yes he can use it just as much as
he can take hunt actions etc.

> 2) A is bleeding me; my B tries to block; A plays sup. Feceless night and
> passes through, then he plays Threats; can B play a Deflection before
being
> tapped?

Hmm I think it works like this: if he doesn't say he declines to bock he can
play the Deflection since he cannot be tapped already because he could
potentially play another intercept if he wanted (and must be untapped for
that unless he played a Wake) but if he decline sto block the Faceless will
have effect and he cannot then bounce...?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Francois Villon wrote:
>
> 1) can Beast the leatherface enter combat with a vamp with a Haven Uncovered
> on him (by using it, obviously, so with a +1 stealth action)?

Yes.

> 2) A is bleeding me; my B tries to block; A plays sup. Feceless night and
> passes through, then he plays Threats; can B play a Deflection before being
> tapped?

Yes. B could also play Enhanced Senses. If B couldn't play reaction cards
before being tapped, he also couldn't block before being tapped, and FN would
be a powerful card indeed.
